775050101.text: This martial arts manual my sister sent back is amazing!

775050102.text: I just made a few rounds south of the station, knocked some sense into a few unruly Polyarbears, and got my blood pumping...

775050103.text: Then suddenly, click! Inspiration struck! Now, let me think how to put it into words... Ideally, in a way that'll help you put it to use right away.

775050104.text: Oh? Is that the Introduction to Fontaine Martial Arts you mentioned before? I'd love to take a look at it, too...

775050105.text: Sure! It's right over there, so help yourself. Just don't forget to bring it back when you're done.

775050107.text: Huh? Paimon didn't even notice Chichikova was gone!

775050108.text: Hehe, doesn't that just prove how good my footwork is? I come and go without leaving a trace!

775050109.text: Let's see how your exploration plan is coming along...

775050110.text: W—Whoa... Seriously!? You're this far already? It's only been a few days! Da Xi'er spent over a month on hers, and she didn't even get a fifth as far as you...

775050113.text: I've never met newcomers this amazing before... Actually, I've never even heard of any!

775050114.text: Please, you have to share your tips with everyone. It'll help the other newcomers improve at least three times faster than before!

775050115.text: Don't worry, we were planning to do that anyway!

775050116.text: #Right, {NICKNAME}? Let's think of a way to explain it that's nice and easy to understand...

775050117.text: After going over how best to phrase things with Paimon, you add a short entry to Chichikova's Adventure Tips Handbook, summarizing what you've learned from your travels through Snezhnaya and highlighting a few points newcomers should keep in mind...\nThese include, but are not limited to: how to predict the movements of wild animals, how to make effective use of Prime Ice Constructs when exploring uncharted areas, and how to observe monster groups from the shadows to gauge their danger level and detection range...

775050118.text: From your Natlan friend's point of view, perhaps this counts as its own kind of "Hero's Wit," too?

775050119.text: See? I knew I had an eye for talent! Two genius newcomers, spotted just like that.

775050120.text: From now on, you're core members of the Mutual Aid Network!

775050121.text: And when my sister gets back, I'll introduce you. You might even learn a few more secret techniques from her — exclusive tricks of the Fatui elite!

775050122.text: Hehe, then when the time comes, we'll be in your sister's care!
